news.title: Your first HYROX: pace it properly
news.summary: Going too hard on run one is the quickest way to pay for it at the sled push.
news.take: Your first race isn't about a PB. Finish strong, learn what your body can do, then build from there.

news.title: Do the things you're not good at
news.summary: Prioritising three or four runs each week turned harder miles into easier, quicker work.
news.take: Progress comes from giving the weak point proper attention, not avoiding it.

news.title: Performance first. Process always.
news.summary: Strength, confidence and longevity come before chasing a number on the scales.
news.take: When the foundations are solid, results become the by-product of doing things properly.
